title: Short-Sale Commission Allowance by Contract Price Band
content:
## Short-sale commission allowance by contract price — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the short-sale commission allowance, part of the allowed closing costs, is the contract commission up to a percentage of the contract price that follows the price band:

| Contract price on the purchase contract submission | Commission limit |
|---|---|
| USD 1000000.00 or more | 5 percent of the contract price |
| at least USD 500000.00 and below USD 1000000.00 | 5.5 percent of the contract price |
| below USD 500000.00 | no adjustment under this schedule |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Contract price | Band | Commission limit |
|---|---|---|
| USD 1000000.00 | top band | USD 50000.00 |
| USD 999999.00 | middle band | USD 54999.95 (5.5 percent, rounded half up to the cent) |
| USD 500000.00 | middle band | USD 27500.00 |
| USD 499999.00 | below the bands | no adjustment under this schedule |

The allowance is the lesser of the contract commission and the limit: a hypothetical commission of USD 30000.00 on a USD 600000.00 contract is limited to USD 33000.00 and so allowed in full.
